headline: Google introduces Gemma 4 12B, a unified multimodal model, while SpaceX is rejected from the S&P 500
tldr: Today in AI, Google unveiled Gemma 4 12B, a laptop-friendly multimodal model, and SpaceX was blocked from the S&P 500. Meanwhile, startups are shifting focus towards 'together tech' and in-person experiences. Researchers are also exploring new AI models and techniques, including fine-tuning for emotion recognition and automating LLM prompts.

new_models.title: Google Gemma 4 12B: Architecture, Benchmarks, Access, and Hands-on Guide for Developers
new_models.summary: Google introduced Gemma 4 12B Unified, an open-source multimodal model designed to understand text, images, audio, and video within a single architecture.
new_models.why_it_matters: This new model has the potential to revolutionize multimodal understanding and generation, enabling more efficient and effective AI applications.

new_models.title: Thousand Token Wood: shipping a multi-agent economy on a 3B model
new_models.summary: The Thousand Token Wood project demonstrates a multi-agent economy on a 3B model, showcasing the potential for complex simulations and interactions.
new_models.why_it_matters: This project highlights the capabilities of large language models in simulating complex systems and economies, with potential applications in fields like finance and urban planning.

research.title: How to Fine-Tune an SLM for Emotion Recognition
research.summary: This tutorial provides a step-by-step guide on fine-tuning a Mistral Small 3.1 model for emotion recognition in social media communication.
research.why_it_matters: Emotion recognition is a crucial aspect of natural language processing, and fine-tuning models for specific tasks can significantly improve their performance and accuracy.

research.title: Automate Writing Your LLM Prompts
research.summary: This article explores the use of DSPy to automatically create, evaluate, and optimize LLM prompts, streamlining the prompt engineering process.
research.why_it_matters: Automating prompt engineering can save time and effort, enabling researchers and developers to focus on more complex tasks and improving the overall efficiency of LLM-based applications.

features_updates.title: How OpenAI Built a Secure Windows Sandbox for Codex Agents
features_updates.summary: OpenAI details the design of a secure Windows sandbox for Codex agents, showcasing the use of SIDs, ACLs, restricted tokens, and dedicated sandbox accounts.
features_updates.why_it_matters: Secure sandboxing is essential for safe execution of autonomous coding tasks, and this design provides a valuable example for developers and researchers working with AI agents.

industry_business.title: The most interesting startups right now want to get you off your phone
industry_business.summary: Startups like Board and Cyberdeck are focusing on in-person experiences and games, marking a shift towards 'together tech'
industry_business.why_it_matters: This trend indicates a growing interest in balancing technology use with real-world interactions, potentially leading to new business opportunities and social benefits.

industry_business.title: The ‘together tech’ wave might be the most intriguing startup bet of 2026
industry_business.summary: The 'together tech' wave is gaining momentum, with startups exploring new ways to bring people together through in-person experiences and social interactions.
industry_business.why_it_matters: This trend has the potential to create new markets and opportunities for startups, while also addressing concerns around social isolation and technology addiction.

industry_business.title: S&P 500 rejects SpaceX, also blocking entry for OpenAI and Anthropic
industry_business.summary: SpaceX was rejected from the S&P 500 due to its unprofitable status, also affecting OpenAI and Anthropic.
industry_business.why_it_matters: This decision highlights the challenges faced by unprofitable companies, including those in the AI sector, in accessing major indexes and securing funding.

policy_society.title: Presentation: Platform Teams Enabling AI - MCP/Multi-Agentic Tools Across Linkedin
policy_society.summary: LinkedIn's Karthik Ramgopal and Prince Valluri discuss the potential of AI as a new execution model for large-scale engineering, highlighting the importance of platform abstractions and safe tooling.
policy_society.why_it_matters: As AI becomes increasingly integrated into various industries, it is essential to develop platform abstractions and safe tooling to ensure efficient and secure execution of AI-based tasks.
